about: One theme switch as both halves of the app see it. src-tauri/tests/omarchy_theme.rs writes `palette` into a theme folder, points the Omarchy-shaped `current/theme` link at it and requires the theme:changed event to carry exactly `roles`; src/lib/themeFollow.test.ts sends that event through Tauri's event plumbing and requires the window to show `roles`.
palette:
background = "#282828"
foreground = "#d4be98"
accent = "#7daea3"
bright_foreground = "#ddc7a1"
bright_magenta = "#d3869b"
bright_yellow = "#d8a657"
